marketing_description: The United Window & Door 4500 Series Sliding Patio Door, part number 1517603, features a vinyl frame and door with a LowE Arg w/J door finish, and is available in a black/white color option. This 2-panel door includes features such as dual corrosion-resistant rollers, a dual-walled sill tower, and a fiberglass mesh screen. The door is designed with a multi-chambered frame and fusion welded heavy-duty vinyl for added durability.
